title: A limit contained in a constructible subset is contained at a finite stage
statement: Let $I$ be directed, let $(S_i)$ be an inverse system of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with affine transition maps and limit $S$ [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition], and fix $i$. Let $E\subseteq S_i$ be locally constructible [def-weil-constructible-subset]. If the projection $S\to S_i$ has image contained in $E$, then for some $i'\ge i$ the image of $S_{i'}\to S_i$ is contained in $E$.

source.place: Limits, Lemma 32.4.10 (label lemma-limit-contained-in-constructible), Tag 05F4; statement extracted from source (proof uses Lemma 32.4.9, Tag 05F3).
